summary: Wrote pnr/floorplan.json (core_utilization_pct=45 with reasons for utilization, pins, power grid and clock/reset) and pnr/pin_order.cfg covering all 65 ports with simple patterns (exact port names plus tx_data.*, clk_div.*, rx_data.*). No tool was run by me; the floorplan, PDN and pin-order parser checks are left to the runtime.
assumptions: Approximate core size (~111 x 111 um) is estimated from area/utilization; actual die size is computed by the flow.
Default SKY130 PDN strap width/pitch is adequate for a ~111 um core; no custom PDN settings.
Pin-order patterns are matched as full-name matches (OpenLane appends an end anchor), so 'clk' does not match clk_div[*], 'start' does not match start_err, and 'cs_n' does not match cs_mode.
Port list is exactly the spec interfaces (65 bits): 42 input pins and 23 output pins; arch.yaml adds no top-level ports.
open_issues: If the runtime's pattern matcher is a prefix match rather than a full match, 'clk', 'start' and 'cs_n'-style names may overlap with clk_div, start_err; the parser feedback will show this.

self_assessment.reason: Utilization is inside range and every port is covered once by construction, but nothing has been checked by the real floorplan/PDN tools yet.
